requestAnalysis.originalRequest:
## Purpose

Disposable installed-adopter acceptance for #321. The owner authorizes triage and refinement of the bounded implementation below, including the normal automatic implementation continuation under installed policy. No merge, release or deployment is authorized. The owner will separately orchestrate duplicate requests and inspect continuation receipts; those observations are not additional implementation tasks.

## Bounded implementation

Add `docs/process/issue-321-delivery-fixture.md` containing exactly the heading `# Delivery reconciliation fixture` and the paragraph `This disposable candidate exercises deduplicated delivery and authenticated bot continuation.` Include the normal completed docs-only OpenSpec plan for this issue, with `skip_specs: true` and the existing citation conventions. This is a small technical fixture for already defined delivery behavior; no new product intent, runtime capability or model change is requested. Preserve all unrelated files and the canonical product and architecture models.

## Worker acceptance

- Triage and refine this defined scope through the normal installed contracts. The owner has authorized its bounded implementation; this fixture has no unresolved product or design decision.
- Deliver the exact document and completed OpenSpec plan together in one implementation PR.
- Return the candidate for the normal independent host installation, repository verification, strict OpenSpec validation and required CI. Avoid repeating full installation or repository verification inside the agent solely for this small fixture.
- Do not add acceptance instrumentation, workflow changes or reports about owner-orchestrated observations to the candidate. Do not wait for those later observations or claim they have passed.
- The disposable PR must never merge. The owner will retain the observations and close the issue and PR without merging.
